integrity: The proof is deductive and uses published return-word and finite-extension arguments. No finite experiment is presented as an infinite proof, and the unavailable related manuscript is recorded as a residual overlap risk rather than treated as checked.
scientific_limitations: The extension must be minimal and finite with a locally constant permutation cocycle. The proof gives existence of a linear-recurrence constant but does not optimize it. A related manuscript cited as work in preparation by Kang and Jäger was not publicly inspectable.
title: Minimal permutative lifts preserve linear recurrence
